news.title: Construction of houses for Wayanad rehabilitation to be completed by Oct-end: Minister
news.para: The construction of homes in the Wayanad rehabilitation township is on track, with a completion date set for the end of October. The contractor is focused on delivering all 110 houses as planned. Additionally, a review will allow for the inclusion of disaster victims initially overlooked. By December, basic infrastructure work will be completed, followed by a beneficiary selection process via a draw.

news.title: Patna civic body launches 15-day drive to recover ₹80 crore property tax due
news.para: The Patna Municipal Corporation has launched a dedicated fifteen-day campaign to assess property taxes. This initiative focuses on incorporating unassessed properties while also re-evaluating existing ones. The goal is to recover around eighty crore rupees in outstanding tax payments. Special teams will prioritize new assessments and target major defaulters, utilizing electricity consumer data to discover properties that have evaded taxation.

news.title: Delhi: Only three PG buildings out of 1,355 found 'visibly dangerous' in MCD survey, nine found repairable
news.para: The Municipal Corporation of Delhi has conducted a survey revealing three hazardous paying-guest buildings, housing a total of sixty-nine residents who urgently need relocation. Additionally, nine more structures were marked for substantial repairs. Reflecting heightened vigilance post the recent collapse in Satya Niketan, authorities have demolished 111 properties and sealed off 88 within just four days.

news.title: Nagpur civic body rules out amnesty to defaulters as tax recovery drive gathers pace
news.para: The Nagpur Municipal Corporation has turned down a proposed property tax amnesty scheme. This decision coincides with their intensified campaign to recover outstanding dues from major defaulters. The standing committee chairperson highlighted the importance of fairness to diligent taxpayers. As part of their strategy, the civic body is now proceeding with property seizures and issuing warnings about possible service disconnections.

news.title: DDA holds consultations on Delhi master plan 2047 implementation
news.para: The Delhi Development Authority has initiated discussions regarding the implementation of the Master Plan for Delhi 2047. Key focus areas included enhancing inter-departmental collaboration and strategies for transport-oriented development. Additionally, notable conversations covered topics such as industrial zones, infrastructure growth, heritage conservation, and land pooling, all aimed at ensuring a synchronized approach towards effective execution of the Master Plan.

news.title: In Noida’s PG belt, buildings rise nine floors where two are allowed, cables dangle at arms reach
news.para: Noida villages are experiencing a worrying rise in illegal multi-storey paying guest accommodations, which frequently disregard necessary fire safety measures and emergency exits. Many of these properties flout building codes, raising valid structural safety concerns. Despite this, tenants, mainly students and IT workers, often compromise their safety for lower rents and convenience, perpetuating a cycle of unchecked construction driven by high demand.

news.title: Delhi high court fixes deadline for final property conversion policy
news.para: The Delhi High Court has rebuked government authorities for their sluggishness regarding the leasehold to freehold property conversion policy. With a looming deadline for submissions set for the September twenty-eighth hearing, countless residents continue to endure unacceptable delays. The court pointed out the disarray in inter-departmental communication and the stalled applications, even as conversion fees have been collected by the DDA.

news.title: Mumbai civic body rolls out OC amnesty scheme for 20,000 buildings occupied before 2016
news.para: Mumbai's civic body has launched an amnesty scheme for older buildings.  This initiative aims to regularize around twenty thousand occupied structures.  Eligible buildings will receive discounts on various regularization charges.  The scheme covers residential, hospital, and school buildings with specific area limits.  Applications must be submitted online through the AutoDCR system.

news.title: Gurugram court orders FIR against Ramprastha Promoters' ex-director for fund diversion
news.para: A city court has mandated the filing of an FIR against a former director and nine accomplices suspected of diverting company funds and committing various serious offenses. The court has instructed the police to ensure a thorough investigation into the alleged financial misconduct, which includes the removal of computers and sensitive records, alongside tampering with account access.

news.title: Telangana high court questions plot reclassification in Durgam Cheruvu land auction
news.para: The Telangana High Court has raised concerns over the recent layout modifications adjacent to Durgam Cheruvu. It demanded clarity regarding the reclassification of plots that were initially designated for preservation. A public interest litigation contests the e-auction of the 10-acre area, while the state contends that heritage rocks are situated outside the auction zone. The court has instructed the government to submit a comprehensive counter-affidavit.

news.title: Chandigarh tenants, landlords to get UIN as UT administration notifies new tenancy rules
news.para: In Chandigarh, all tenancy agreements are now required to be registered online within a two-month period. Upon registration, both landlords and tenants will be assigned a unique identification number within seven days. This initiative is designed to enhance transparency and accountability in tenancy affairs, while a robust three-tier system will assist in resolving any disputes that may arise regarding rent. These regulations will be enforced throughout the Union Territory.

news.title: Delhi LG approves high-powered panel to boost student accommodation facilities in city
news.para: Delhi's Lieutenant Governor has greenlighted a robust committee to evaluate the housing requirements for students. This inter-agency group will focus on securing land and exploring innovative accommodation possibilities. Additionally, they will devise emergency response protocols and implement a digital monitoring framework aimed at enhancing safety and alleviating overcrowding in student housing. Recommendations will be forthcoming within a two-month timeframe.

news.title: CBI conducts searches at 12 locations in builder banking nexus case; five new FIRs filed
news.para: The CBI carried out searches at twelve sites across three cities, resulting in the registration of five fresh fraud cases against real estate developers. This initiative aligns with Supreme Court directives aimed at addressing the concerns of homebuyers. During these searches, the agency seized crucial incriminating documents and digital devices, escalating the total number of cases against builders to fifty-five.

news.title: Sumadhura Group plans ₹17,000 crore investment, 45 million sq ft development by 2030
news.para: Sumadhura Group plans to launch 45 million sq ft of development across residential, commercial and warehousing segments in Bengaluru, Hyderabad and Chennai by 2030. The roadmap is backed by a planned investment of ₹17,000 crore.

news.title: Hiranandani Communities enters Goa real estate market through project management partnerships
news.para: Eleva by Hiranandani will provide project management consultancy services for two residential projects in Goa. The developments, spread across five acres, have a combined project value of ₹450 crore and will add about 0.25 million sq ft of development.

news.title: MHADA begins allotment of 574 rehab homes in Worli BDD chawl redevelopment project
news.para: The Maharashtra Housing and Area Development Authority (MHADA) is set to distribute 574 rehabilitation flats in the Worli BDD Chawl redevelopment initiative. The distribution has commenced following the receipt of occupancy certificates for two wings. Capacite Infraprojects has delivered towers B and C, offering 552 apartments, with possession being handed out in phases corresponding to construction completion and certificate acquisition.

news.title: Twenty three years on, Bengaluru’s 1,134 Arkavathy Layout allottees still await sites
news.para: Over a thousand original Arkavathy Layout allottees remain without sites after twenty-three years. The Bangalore Development Authority originally planned twenty thousand sites for this project. Litigation and denotification scandals significantly reduced the available plots for allotment. Many affected individuals have pursued legal recourse and presented evidence. The BDA continues efforts to accommodate remaining allottees as litigation resolves.

news.title: Identify land parcels for student PGs: LG to Delhi development body
news.para: The Delhi government is set to launch a new initiative aimed at ensuring safe and budget-friendly paying guest accommodations for students. Under the directive of the Lieutenant Governor, the DDA is tasked with locating appropriate land for this purpose. Collaborations between universities and external providers are planned for optimized student housing.

news.title: Green NOCs missing, Uttar Pradesh pollution control board shut 15 hotels, restaurants in last two years
news.para: In a decisive action against pollution in the region, the UP Pollution Control Board has mandated the closure of fifteen hotels and restaurants. Additionally, show-cause notices have been issued to fifty-eight more establishments following a thorough review. Out of 625 establishments in Ghaziabad, only 241 have been surveyed so far. For those that didn’t comply, closure orders have been enforced, and electricity connections cut.
